question_text: The stacked bar chart below shows the breakdown of expenditures (in millions of pesos) for four municipalities: Alaminos, Bani, Dasol, and Infanta. Each bar is divided into three categories: Health, Education, and Infrastructure. Alaminos spent a total of ₱120 million, with Health at ₱30 million, Education at ₱50 million, and Infrastructure at ₱40 million. Bani spent a total of ₱80 million, with Health at ₱20 million, Education at ₱30 million, and Infrastructure at ₱30 million. Dasol spent a total of ₱100 million, with Health at ₱25 million, Education at ₱35 million, and Infrastructure at ₱40 million. Infanta spent a total of ₱90 million, with Health at ₱15 million, Education at ₱45 million, and Infrastructure at ₱30 million. Which municipality allocated the highest percentage of its total expenditure to Education?
